links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of top LLM versus medical students and attending physician on same questions
links.effect: o4-mini-high achieved 94% accuracy; human accuracies ranged from 38.5% (three medical students) to 70.5% (attending physician), all significantly lower than the LLM.
links.quote: The human accuracies in this cohort ranged from 38.5% for three medical students to 70.5% for an attending physician-all significantly lower than OpenAI o4-mini-high.

unlisted_practices: Chain-of-thought and few-shot prompt engineering to correct LLM diagnostic errors
Error-type taxonomy analysis of LLM diagnostic mistakes (logic vs input processing)

screen.reason: Evaluated multimodal LLMs on the NEJM Image Challenge benchmark compared to clinicians, and explicitly tested prompt engineering strategies (chain-of-thought and few-shot learning) to correct diagnostic errors.
